name: First greeting
text: Ah, the new gaffer. Let's see if you survive until Christmas.
Welcome to the league. Keep your lads off my training pitch.
Fresh face, eh? Don't get in my way.
Alright, boss. Ready to make some noise?

name: Greeting friendly
text: Alright gaffer! Good to see you.
Always a pleasure. Your lads played beautiful stuff at the weekend.
Great to see you, mate. Let's build something special.
Good on ya. Your tactics are getting sharper by the day.

name: Greeting neutral
text: Make it quick, I've got a training session in ten minutes.
What do you want? Speak your mind and leave.
Not in the mood for small talk today, boss.
Right then, what's on your mind?

name: Greeting hostile
text: Look who it is. Don't expect to take any points off us.
The fans hate you, the board hates you, and I'm not your biggest fan either.
Your lot couldn't organize a proper kickabout at the pub.
We'll tear you apart when we meet. Mark my words.

name: Trade accepted
text: The paperwork is signed. Good piece of business.
We accept. Pleasure doing business with you.
Right then, we've got ourselves a deal.
Cheers for that. Fair trade between fair competitors.

name: Trade rejected
text: Are you taking the piss? You couldn't buy my kitman with that offer.
My board would sack me if I accepted this. Try again.
That's an insult to my intelligence, that is.
Not a chance, mate. That's a rubbish deal.

name: Declaring war
text: The gloves are off. The firm's mobilized, and we're taking your stadium apart!
We are here to embarrass you in front of your own fans!
Time to settle this on the pitch. Prepare yourself.
It's on now. We're coming for you with everything we've got!

name: Defeated
text: Sacked in the morning... We've gone into administration, and it's your fault.
You didn't beat me tactically, you bought the league! Disgraceful!
This isn't over. We'll be back stronger.
Fair play, but next season's ours.
